title: A day row's Total Hours links to Timesheet Activities for that technician on that single day
custom_preconds: 1. A technician row is expanded and shows day rows.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Total Hours value on one day row.
2. Read the technician filter and the date range on the opened Timesheet Activities report.
custom_expected:
1. Timesheet Activities opens filtered to that technician.
2. The date range covers ONLY that single day.
